evidence.reason: The fixture initializes a repository and changes the committer identity but never disables inherited commit signing before creating fixture commits. With a developer-global `commit.gpgSign=true`, Git attempts to sign using the fixture identity (`fixture@example.invalid`); without a matching key, the first commit fails and every DeployTests case errors in setUp(). This is an ordinary test correctness defect, and the smallest compatible fix is to set repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first commit.
